What we'd like to do is to fix what's been in effect all along and that is that farmers and ranchers shouldn't have to go to the federal government and report releases of manure. That's common sense. The challenge here is to get enough people on board to get it attached to piece of legislation that could move forward in a fairly quick fashion.
